title: Xiaoxi: everyday bookkeeping, personal assets and shared goals
excerpt: Local-first bookkeeping for iPhone and iPad, with screenshot recognition and optional iCloud.
content:
Xiaoxi (小西记账) is a local-first bookkeeping app for iPhone and iPad. Everyday records are stored on your device and remain usable offline. You can enable iCloud when you want to use your data across devices.

[View Xiaoxi on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761647747) · [Help and support](https://cloudmantoua.top/post/xiaoxi-jizhang-support) · [Privacy policy](https://cloudmantoua.top/post/xiaoxi-jizhang-privacy)

## Understand your everyday spending

Record income, expenses and transfers. Manage categories, accounts and budgets, and review monthly totals, trends and a transaction calendar. CSV import includes duplicate checks and export is supported.

WeChat and Alipay transaction screenshots can be recognized on the device to prepare a draft entry. Recognition can make mistakes: check the amount, date, direction and category before saving.

## Manage the things you own and want

Asset records track purchase price, additional costs, current value and sale details. A wishlist keeps target prices and price history alongside your everyday bookkeeping.

## What's coming in 1.1.0

Multiple ledgers, sharing, savings goals and versioned backups are provided with 1.1.0. This version is being prepared for App Store release; the store page determines which version is currently available.

- Multiple ledgers: separate personal, family and travel statistics and budgets. Existing transactions migrate into the personal ledger.
- Shared bookkeeping: create a family or couple's ledger and invite specific people through Apple's iCloud sharing. Each member uses their own iCloud account on iPhone or iPad.
- Savings goals: set an amount and date. Progress is cumulative ledger income minus expenses. The app only records changes: it does not provide bank accounts, payments, money transfers or custody of funds.
- Versioned backups: save a complete snapshot in your own iCloud and preview the impact before restoring. Backups are separate from synchronization.
- Category and rule synchronization: custom categories and local recognition rules can sync through your personal iCloud.

## You choose what to share

Only ledgers you explicitly share are opened to invited members. Personal assets, wishlists and recognition rules stay private. Members with edit access can modify all transactions in the shared ledger. The system schedules synchronization; offline edits sync progressively after reconnecting, rather than behaving like real-time chat.

Revoking access cannot recall copies other members have already exported, captured or saved. Invite people you trust and review the ledger before sharing.

## Getting started

Requires iOS / iPadOS 15 or later. Basic bookkeeping needs no Xiaoxi account. iCloud features require an Apple account on the device and permission for the app to use iCloud.

See the [support page](https://cloudmantoua.top/post/xiaoxi-jizhang-support) for help.
